newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador to sell off railway assets - official.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador to sell off railway assets - official.

text.p: Ecuador will sell off the assets of its state railway company and then tender its routes to private bidders, a top government privatization official said Monday.
"There will be concession for the routes, whether for cargo or tourism," Raul Gangotena, director of the government's National Modernization Council, told Reuters in an interview.
"Concessions could well be granted this year," he said, but without giving any date for the start of the process.
Gangotena said the government plans to grant the concessions at the same time as it liquidates its railway assets.
The government of former President Sixto Duran called a rail privatization tender in 1995, but there were few offers.
